parameters.query:
WITH payload AS (
  SELECT
    '{{$node['Validate + Canonicalize Mission'].json.mission_id_sql}}'::text AS mission_id,
    '{{$node['Validate + Canonicalize Mission'].json.created_by_sql}}'::text AS created_by,
    '{{$node['Validate + Canonicalize Mission'].json.parts_json_sql}}'::jsonb AS parts
), wipe AS (
  DELETE FROM gov.mission_parts
  WHERE mission_id = (SELECT mission_id FROM payload)
), ins AS (
  INSERT INTO gov.mission_parts (mission_id, part_id, goal, executor_id, priority, order_index, status, created_by)
  SELECT
    p.mission_id,
    LEFT(COALESCE(NULLIF(item.value->>'part_id',''), 'P' || item.ord::text), 40) AS part_id,
    LEFT(COALESCE(NULLIF(item.value->>'goal',''), 'definir entrega'), 500) AS goal,
    CASE WHEN upper(COALESCE(item.value->>'executor_id','CPP')) IN ('STAFF','CPP','CPP-IA') THEN upper(item.value->>'executor_id') ELSE 'CPP' END AS executor_id,
    CASE WHEN upper(COALESCE(item.value->>'priority','P1')) IN ('P0','P1','P2') THEN upper(item.value->>'priority') ELSE 'P1' END AS priority,
    item.ord::int AS order_index,
    'pending'::text AS status,
    p.created_by
  FROM payload p, jsonb_array_elements(p.parts) WITH ORDINALITY AS item(value, ord)
  RETURNING mission_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS parts_count FROM ins;
